english.title: Obstruct a constable / inspector authorised to investigate an animal regulated procedures offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally obstructed **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),

(A)_[a constable,]_
(B)_[an inspector,]_

in the exercise of

(C)_[his]_
(D)_[her]_

powers under section 25 of the Animals (Scientific Procedures) Act 1986
english.legislation: Contrary to section 25(3)(a) of the Animals (Scientific Procedures) Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
intentionally obstruct a constable/inspector
in the exercise of his / her powers
under s. 25 Animals (Scientific Procedures) Act 1986

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Imprisonment for this offence will be abolished when section 332 and Sct 37 Pt 9 of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 is brought into force.
(ii) Time limit for prosecutions - within three years after the commission of the offence and within six months after the date on which evidence sufficient in the opinion of the Director of Public Prosecutions to justify the proceedings comes to his knowledge.

other.penalty:
Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Within three years after the commission of the offence and within six months after the date on which evidence sufficient in the opinion of the Director of Public Prosecutions to justify the proceedings comes to his knowledge.
